params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output ('GH_TOKEN_PRESENT=' + [bool](-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:GH_TOKEN))); Write-Output ('GITHUB_TOKEN_PRESENT=' + [bool](-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:GITHUB_TOKEN))); Write-Output ('WINGET_PRESENT=' + [bool](Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)); Write-Output ('CHOCO_PRESENT=' + [bool](Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)); Write-Output ('SCOOP_PRESENT=' + [bool](Get-Command scoop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)); $env:GCM_INTERACTIVE='Never'; $credIn="protocol=https`nhost=github.com`n`n"; $filled=($credIn | git credential fill 2>$null | Out-String); $hasUser=[bool]($filled -match '(?m)^username=.+$'); $hasPassword=[bool]($filled -match '(?m)^password=.+$'); Write-Output ('GIT_CREDENTIAL_USER_PRESENT=' + $hasUser); Write-Output ('GIT_CREDENTIAL_SECRET_PRESENT=' + $hasPassword); Write-Output ('CURL_PRESENT=' + [bool](Get-Command curl.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))
